text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whewie! My shoulders feel like mashed
roe! I must've had so much
tension built
up. Director, this massage machine really
works wonders!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Objection! This is not a massage machine!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
What a wild turn of events. Grass, El, are
you both okay?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
We're golden! No te preocupes! The
machine was super fun.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but I should tell ya one thing,
King...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You're dead wrong about who's the world's
weakest.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Right, Grass? No way I'm the world's
weakest, right?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Of course not. What you did today was
remarkable. Your performance
was
amazing.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Claro que sí! But in the end,
you stole the
spotlight with that final
blow.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Only because you showed me the way.

text_block_list.name: Uma Lord Golshi
text_block_list.text:
What?! How are you accelerating so fast? I
thought you'd used up all
your skills!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I don't need any fantasy skills! This is a
racecourse, the place where
an
Umamusume's true magic shines!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
What matters most is power and
endurance!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Those words helped me see past the
legend's lightning metaphors to
my true
innate power. You see...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
We're blessed with incredible leg
strength,
as well as enough physical
fortitude to
withstand the potion sickness debuff.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I put the pieces together and realized
that
a titanic Umamusume kick
would strike
harder than any bolt.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Just like when you won the race. Even with
all the magic flying
around, your own two
legs are what carried you to the finish
line.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You said it yourself. We put everything on
the line for the sake of one
thing—victory.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Even in the face of danger, our desire to
reach the finish line remains
unshaken.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
And while the game world was fictional,
we weren't just playing
around.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I ran as fast as I could,
just like in
real races!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. The shining goddess who lends
power to Umanest's
adventurers is just a
character, but...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Our Goddess of Victory motivates us to
keep running, no matter when
or where.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Sí! You hit the nail on the head!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Ooh! I'm... so... inspired!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
This VR Umalator is designed not only to
help Umamusume acquire
new skills, but
to develop new bonds as well!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Things didn't go quite to plan this time,
but we're working on
updating the system
to connect with even more worlds!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Wait, so you're planning to expand this
function?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I need to install a fail-safe program
just in case things get out of hand
again... Forced shutdowns are too risky,
and I doubt I'd be allowed to
do one anyway...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: This time, it was the legend. Next time...

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Did you say something, Tazuna?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: No, I was just talking to myself. ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha. Still,
this looks like a great way
to kill some time. I can't
wait for the next
installment. ♪

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: So, who wants to be our next challenger?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Again?! I'll give it another shot! I wanna
go! And Grass, I want you
with me!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
El...
Haven't you had your fair share of fun
already?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No way! I say keep the challenges comin'
and comin'! Let's play
together more!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hey Director,
where's the coin slot on this
thing? Oh, and does it take
pesos?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
El, that's enough. We have training today,
remember?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: But Grass! It's one more go! Just one!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You're like a little child...
If you don't stop
your whining, you won't
get any dinner.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Anything but thaaaat!
